1.text:
AI/ML: LangChain, FAISS, LLM APIs (OpenAI/Anthropic), basic scikit-learn

Infrastructure & DevOps: Docker, Docker Compose, Redis, Celery

Security: AES-256 encryption, cryptographic key management, LSB steganography

Databases: MySQL, MongoDB

Tools: Git/GitHub, Postman, VS Code

Practice: 250+ LeetCode problems across arrays, DP, graphs, trees and binary search | Followed Striver's SDE Sheet.

PROJECTS

Steganography Tool with AES-256 Encryption | Python,Cryptography,SignalProcessing

Links: github.com/ravishankar-c/stego-aes256

Built a data-hiding tool that conceals text inside audio and video files (MP3/MP4) using AES-256 encryption, combining cryptography with steganography for covert, secure communication.

2.text:
Implemented Least Significant Bit (LSB) encoding to embed data with zero perceptible change to media quality, preserving both audio fidelity and video integrity.

Designed a dual-layer security pipeline requiring both a cryptographic key and a separate extraction password, so decryption fails without both factors — reducing single-point compromise risk.

DocuMind — RAG-Based Document Q&A System | Python,LangChain,FAISS,LLMAPIs,FastAPI

Links: github.com/ravishankar-c/documind-rag | documind-demo.streamlit.app

Built a Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) pipeline that lets users upload documents (PDF/DOCX) and ask natural-language questions, returning answers grounded in the source text instead of hallucinated content.

3.text:
Implemented document chunking and embedding generation, storing vectors in a FAISS index for fast semantic similarity search across large document sets.

Designed a retrieval-then-generate flow that fetches the top-k relevant chunks before passing them to an LLM, and added citation of source passages so answers are verifiable rather than opaque.

Exposed the pipeline via a FastAPI backend with a simple chat UI, supporting multi-document sessions and persistent conversation context.

Distributed Task Queue & Rate-Limited API Gateway | Python,Celery,Redis,Docker,FastAPI

Links: github.com/ravishankar-c/task-queue-gateway

4.text:
Distributed Task Queue & Rate-Limited API Gateway | Python,Celery,Redis,Docker,FastAPI

Links: github.com/ravishankar-c/task-queue-gateway

Designed an asynchronous job-processing system using Celery + Redis, fronted by a FastAPI gateway with token-bucket rate limiting per client to protect downstream services.

Containerized all services with Docker Compose, added retry-with-backoff for failed jobs, and exposed a monitoring endpoint for queue depth and task latency.

ACHIEVEMENTS & LEADERSHIP
